description: The advanced OpenCode window, and the least this app can give it. The window holds the node's OpenCode UI origin, which is remote content built by a third party and driven by an agent, so it is granted no IPC at all: there is no `remote` section here, which is what decides that the origin loaded in this window can invoke nothing. The four window commands below are `local` only, reachable from a page this app itself serves into the window and from nowhere else. Nothing that manages the node appears here, and no plugin does either: a link off the UI origin is opened in the system browser by this app's own navigation handler, in Rust, never by a command this window could call.
